pre_click_posts:
EURUSD and USDJPY: two falling quotes, two dollar directions




Why it matters: The first chart puts both relationships into currency units per dollar and measures their change from October 26. For the euro, that requires taking the reciprocal of EURUSD; the yen quote already measures what one dollar buys. On this basis, the dollar ended October 30 up 0.13% against the euro and down 0.07% against the yen. The inverted euro rate is calculated from the Fed quote.




Context: Euro- or yen-specific policy expectations and demand for safer assets could outweigh the US yield channel. The October 26-30 Fed reference-rate comparison cannot identify which driver dominated.




Read the full brief: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/eurusd-and-usdjpy-two-falling-quotes




Analysis, not financial advice. Readers decide whether to trade.
